correctness.rationale: Twice apply defining polynomial recursion. For n=4t+1, residue 3 mod 4 is empty; for n=4t+3 residue 2 mod 4 is empty; even n have only even exponents. Therefore no four-term run is possible, while P_5=1+x+x² realizes three. Define I_t=|E_t intersection E_{t+1}| and J_t=#(j in E_t with j+1 in E_{t+1}); parity decomposition yields I_{2u}=I_u, I_{2u+1}=s(u+1), J_{2u}=s(u), J_{2u+1}=J_u. Stern sums give S_k=(3^k-1)/2, U_k=(3^k-1)/2; aggregate adjacent-pair A_r=(3^(r-1)-1)/2 and triple B_r=(3^(r-2)-1)/2; invert C_r-2A_r+B_r etc to exact R1=2h+1,R2=(h+1)/2,R3=(h-1)/2 for all r>=2. Independently generated 4096 polynomial supports and compared them with Lucas parity; all eleven dyadic-prefix run counts and max-3 condition agreed. Finite checks independently corroborate, do not prove the dyadic recurrence.
residual_risks: Claims are dyadic-prefix totals and maximal consecutive coefficient-one intervals, not all sparse-gap patterns or arbitrary Stern polynomial definitions.

value.rationale: Consecutive coefficient runs are a canonical local statistic of the support of a naturally defined automatic-polynomial sequence. A sharp uniform maximum, complete exact run-length distribution at every dyadic scale and universal limiting proportions give reusable local-support information not supplied by coefficient totals or factorization. This is a natural complete classification, not an arbitrary finite slice or known-table reprint.
